lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Hazel Crawford is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Hazel is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Stonebridge watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.
d41: 🕯️ Hazel Crawford is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Hazel kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Hazel's gone." Chester looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Hazel." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Minh blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Keeping Morale (Level 1). People need small wins. Celebrate the little things. Despair is the real killer.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Hazel Crawford, 41 days. The mantle passes to Minh Kwon.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Minh Kwon, 22 — an ESL teacher. Their hands know different work now: The Touch, Translator, Dowsing.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Hazel — and Hazel is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Rocco, Chester, Banyat and 4 more speak for Minh — "Hazel trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Minh before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

lastSay: d111: — DAY 111 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
d111: The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Autumn Crocus — named and noted.
d111: 💬 Yuki whispers: "Mara swears she met a stranger who knew things. Things no one should know. I told her she's tired."
d111: Whatever was at the door has moved on — or found easier meat. The call goes quiet.
d111: Dawn. You wake rested. (+14 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
